Support.title: Support center
Support.intro: Help with digital delivery, payment, and your account — without unverified claims.
Support.contactBody: Channels appear only when the owner configures them in store settings.
Support.noticeMissing: No owner public notice (hours / legal entity) yet.
Support.faqDeliveryQ: When do I receive my digital product?
Support.faqDeliveryA: Only after server-side payment confirmation. Delivery appears in your account or goes to the gift recipient.
Support.faqPayQ: Is returning from the payment page enough?
Support.faqPayA: No. Proof is the server webhook/verification, not the browser redirect alone.
Support.faqGiftQ: Can I see a gift code?
Support.faqGiftA: No — it is hidden from the buyer and intended for the recipient.
Support.policyBody: Digital products are delivered electronically after successful payment. Company addresses or guarantees are not shown unless the owner configures them.

Help.title: Help center
Help.intro: General guidance about orders, delivery, and accounts on Gamers Matrix.
Help.ownerNotice: Company details, official support hours, and registration numbers require owner review before they are treated as legal facts.
Help.ordersBody: Track order status from your account after signing in. Payment and fulfillment status come from server confirmation.
Help.deliveryBody: Keys or links are released only after payment verification. Fulfillment secrets are never exposed in public page source.
Help.accountBody: Use a valid email for order notices once an email provider is configured.
Help.contactBody: Reach us through the contact or support pages.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.intro: Available contact channels for the digital store.
Contact.ownerNotice: Company address, official email, and registration numbers are omitted until the owner provides them.
Contact.whatsappMissing: WhatsApp number not configured in store settings
Contact.hoursBody: Official support hours will come from store settings when available. No invented hours are shown.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: General framework for using the Gamers Matrix digital store.
Terms.ownerNotice: This is guidance text, not legal advice. Have counsel review and complete business entity details before final publication.
Terms.s1Body: We sell legitimate digital products as described. Platform/region compatibility is the buyer’s responsibility at purchase.
Terms.s2Body: You are responsible for account confidentiality. Access may be suspended for abuse or suspected fraud.
Terms.s3Body: Payment is complete only after server-side provider verification, not merely returning from a checkout page.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: How account and order data are handled at a high level.
Privacy.ownerNotice: Data-protection officer details and entity information require owner updates before legal reliance.
Privacy.s1Body: Account data (such as name and email) and order data needed to fulfill purchases and support.
Privacy.s2Body: We use data to fulfill orders, prevent fraud, and improve the service within legal limits.
Privacy.s3Body: Necessary data may be shared with payment or hosting providers for operations. We do not sell your data as a product.

Refund.title: Refund policy
Refund.intro: General principles for digital products on Gamers Matrix.
Refund.ownerNotice: Refund rates, cancellation windows, and special-case rules must be set by the owner before final adoption.
Refund.s1Body: After a valid key or code is delivered, refunds are usually unavailable unless a store-side defect is confirmed.
Refund.s2Body: If delivery fails after confirmed payment, we retry or handle the case via support using order records.
Refund.s3Body: For a specific order, use the account or contact page and include the order reference.
